hook.name: LaunchHook
hook.description: A token launch hook that seeds a single-range liquidity position and charges a high anti-snipe fee (99%) that linearly decays to 1% over 20 seconds post-launch. Only the hook itself can add/remove liquidity. Buy fees are collected via beforeSwap; sell fees via afterSwap. Fees are split between the token creator and a protocol fee escrow.
